name: Rwanda Social Security Board (RSSB)
note: Owner and name sponsor of RSSB Tigers, the 2026 BAL champions; took over Tigers BBC in 2025 (The New Times; Ecofin Agency). Tier left to a maintainer: a state-controlled Rwandan institution plus the Government of Rwanda's documented record (UN Group of Experts, S/2024/432) points to Serious or Severe.

why.text: RSSB — the Rwanda Social Security Board — is the country's social-security board, established by Rwandan law and supervised by the Ministry in charge of finance; it owns the club outright and put its own name on it. Behind it sits the Rwandan state: UN experts say 3,000–4,000 Rwandan troops are fighting alongside M23 rebels in eastern Congo.
